title: A Orchard for the Promise
author: Rafael Ashgrove
blurb: Ulyana Ravensworth, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
